what_to_detect: A modal spell cast with its entwine cost paid resolves every one of its modes.
near_miss: A modal spell with entwine cast without the entwine cost, resolving only the chosen mode.
record_fields: effect halves sharing one link_id, one per chosen mode
card lines: cast_with on the entwine line, chosen on option lines (gen-3)

what_to_detect: The modes of an entwined spell resolve in the order they are written on the card.
near_miss: A modal spell resolving only one mode.
record_fields: effect halves sharing one link_id, in resolution order, each keyed by its option
card lines: cast_with on the entwine line (gen-3)
